versions.changelog:
No user-visible changes detected in this version.

- No file changes found compared to the previous version.
- Functionality, interaction, and rules remain the same as before.

Initial release: Provides a supportive, exam-free daily English speaking practice experience.

- Offers two main modes: free conversation and scenario-based role play, focused on real-life topics.
- Allows users to choose and switch between three difficulty levels (beginner/intermediate/fluent) at any time.
- Features gentle error correction without interrupting conversation flow or overemphasizing grammar.
- Supports after-session review of practical and authentic phrases used during practice.
- Maintains a friendly, encouraging tone, avoiding any evaluative or discouraging feedback.
